hook: Pulling the pin like it owes me money.
beats: Mulligan: I got the pin, I got it—
setting: On the putting green gripping the flagstick with the hole right there in frame, full-body framing.
action: Mulligan heaves on the flagstick with both hands, it suddenly pops free and sends him tumbling backward into a soft plop on the green as he speaks; Birdie watches, unimpressed.

dialogue.speaker: Mulligan
dialogue.line: I got the pin, I got it—

sound: a metal pop, a whoosh, a grassy plop, a giggle
judge: 'It got you' is a crisp surprising reversal with good physical comedy.
